purpose: Machine-readable registry of XAI's product surfaces, modules, and desktop-plugin sub-modules, plus the routing signals and boundary rules used to classify a new feature into exactly one module. Consumed by the xai-module-classify skill and mirrored into the dev-dashboard. This is the data form of docs/MODULE_BOUNDARIES.md + docs/PRODUCT_MODULE_MAP.md.

hard_rules: creating-a-native-window is App-layer Tauri command work (window.rs), NOT plugin work; plugins only consume window commands
Web-already-covered full modules are not re-built as web-form inside plugins; App reuses business-logic packages via the D3 gate
plugin entities default syncScope=device-local and NEVER enter the remote outbox; only explicit account-sync entities sync (ADR-0013 D4)
Web pet/widgets/grid (in-page DOM) are NOT the same as desktop pet/widgets/grid (native overlay) — same name, zero code sharing
web->app only via the D3 gate (xai-web-to-desktop-sync); never merge web directly into dev

frozen_lines.plugin: P2 PAUSED until G1 SHIPPED — brief/impact-note only, no source landing
frozen_lines.sync: P2 PAUSED until G1 SHIPPED — receipt only

modules.name: Mac 桌面版 App
modules.owns_for_plugins: all native window/file/clipboard Tauri commands (plugins consume, never implement)

modules.name: 桌面整理插件 / Widget
signals: 桌面整理/Smart Container/Grid 容器
浮动小组件/便签/进度条/桌宠/剪贴板
modules.form: lightweight overlay/grid window on the App plugin platform
modules.data: device-local by default (never syncs unless explicitly account-sync)

sub_modules.open_decision: P-level reconcile (ADR-0015): web=P2 vs dev ADR-0011=P3; recommend 'shipped foundation, not greenfield'
packaging (ADR-0015): independent package vs widgets desktop-pet sub-module; recommend keep independent

sub_modules.note: NO package on disk yet; Web form shipped as xai-web-meditation

modules.name: 账号云同步层
modules.rule: only account-sync entities sync; device-local never does (ADR-0013 D4)

classification_flow.ask: 命中哪个模块的任务归属信号?
浏览器能否实现且是完整功能页面?
是造原生底座能力,还是用底座做轻量挂件?

classification_flow.yes: entities.ts 标 account-sync -> sync 线 (D4)

classification_flow.ask: 改动源自 Web 要流向 App?
classification_flow.yes: 走 D3 闸门 (W0-W4) via xai-web-to-desktop-sync

drift_checks.rule: every module.surface / sub_module.package path that is a packages/* dir MUST exist on disk; flag Planned-no-package rows (e.g. plugin-meditation, plugin-settings) so docs don't read as if the package exists
every plugin entity MUST declare syncScope in packages/core-data/src/entities.ts; device-local entities must be excluded from the outbox (delegate proof to xai-account-sync-scope-check)
a feature named pet/widgets/grid/dashboard MUST be tagged web-DOM vs desktop-native; they are different modules despite the shared word
no source may land on plugin/sync (PAUSED) or site/admin (PROPOSED) without an operator-confirmed unfreeze
if a feature matches no module signal or matches 2+ with equal weight, escalate to operator instead of guessing

consumers.skill: xai-module-classify (classify a new feature + scan for drift)
consumers.dashboard: docs/prototypes/dev-dashboard/index.html (产品结构图 / module map panel)
